messages:
Olivia B: quick heads-up  weekly KPI flagged a strange double-peak in webinar signups for the March benchmark cohort. before we push to execs, can analytics + eng sanity-check? :wave:

Rahul P: on it. quick glance: two peaks ~03:00 and ~11:00 UTC same day. sessions up ~55% but registrants only moved in the first peak. suspicious—could be a rollup/tz bug or a messaging burst.

Claire W: we shipped the new benchmark narrative email at 10:45 UTC and a reminder at 10:46 for a small subset. that explains the later peak, but the early one at 03:00 UTC is odd (no sends then).

Theo M: flag: data rollup job was patched last week and there was a timezone default reverted from "local" -> "UTC" for daily rollups. that can cause some APAC events to shift into the prior day bucket, creating a phantom early peak. logging here.

Olivia B: two asks: 1) analytics to add a deduped, tz-normalized series to the KPI board and annotate the tz-rollup change; 2) growth to slice signups by send_id so we can isolate the reminder cohort.

Rahul P: will add tz-normalized and deduped lines. SQL sketch for tz-normalization (using event_ts in UTC and user_tz offset):
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + make_interval(secs => user_tz_offset)) AS local_day,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS deduped_signups
FROM signup_events
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2024-03-10' AND '2024-03-18'
GROUP BY local_day
ORDER BY local_day;
```

Theo M: i've queued a backfill to re-run rollups using the corrected timezone setting for 2024-03-10..2024-03-18. command: `airflow trigger_dag rollup_backfill --conf '{"start":"2024-03-10","end":"2024-03-18","tz":"user_local"}'`. ETA ~45m. will post when complete.

Claire W: sending-id slice attached to campaign doc now. reminder send_id=send_20240314_r1; original send_id=send_20240314_a. reminder cohort was ~12% of list.

dashbot: KPI board annotated: "rollup timezone setting corrected; backfill in progress (id: a-20240314-tz)". public board: https://dash.redwood.com/r/benchmarks-tracking

Olivia B: great. last ask: once backfill finishes can analytics post the reconciled weekly snapshot and a 1-paragraph note clarifying: "early UTC spike was a rollup artifact; net uplift attributable to reminder cohort is X% (with CRM lag caveat)" so we don't send noisy exec alerts. thanks all :thumbsup:
